blocks.content: The Provider sits high in the tree, usually near the root. The consumer can be anywhere inside it.
The data travels directly from Provider to consumer. The layers in between don't know or care that the data exists.
When the value in the Provider changes, every component currently reading that value with useContext() re-renders automatically. This is what makes it reactive, just like state.
Let's create one and wire it into our app.
